primary_proof: The actual source depicts a one-course, one-cube-thick wall turning a right corner. Let outer side contain n cubes. The square border has4n-4 cubes, because4corner cubes are counted twice by4full side runs. 4n-4=36 gives n=10. The square strictly inside is (10-2)x(10-2)=8x8, requiring64 new cubes. Equivalently 4m+4=36 gives inner side m=8. The drawing is deliberately a partial wall; its clipped lengths are not full side measurements.
